overview.zh: P4 启动时创建共享队列与互斥量，初始化为 UNCONTROLLABLE 并将多圈位置标为未知，然后创建通信、状态、S3 CAN 接收、舵机总线和运动控制任务。队列/任务创建失败会记录安全规则并阻止装配完成。任务间使用共享运行时状态、快照队列和 wake signals。
overview.en: P4 startup creates shared queues and a mutex, initializes UNCONTROLLABLE and unknown multi-turn positions, then creates host communication, state, S3 CAN RX, servo-bus, and motion-control tasks. Queue/task creation failure records a safety rule and prevents assembly completion. Workers communicate through shared runtime state, snapshot queues, and wake signals.

zh.plain: P4 startup assembly creates shared queues/mutex, sets a conservative startup state, then creates the persistent workers. Failed critical resource creation records a safety rule and returns failure.
zh.condition: 任务节点：P4 任务装配。创建条件、周期及资源配置见本节点和 linked source evidence。
zh.effect: Queue capacities differ by use: state events retain several entries; sensor/servo snapshots use overwrite-style capacity one; control trace and tactile data have their own queues.
zh.failure: The shared context carries state, owner, control enable, scope, feedback and wake signals between tasks.
zh.recovery: Queue/mutex/task/monitor creation failure is an assembly failure; the system must not be treated as ready.
zh.unknown: 源码给出静态任务配置与数据通路，不证明实机调度抖动、堆栈余量或硬件输出结果。
zh.difference: Inspect the recorded assembly rule and resource result before enabling control.
zh.change: 基线没有把该任务标记为本次变更。

en.plain: P4 startup creates shared queues/mutex, sets a conservative initial state, and then creates persistent workers. Failure to create a critical resource records a safety rule and returns failure.
en.condition: 任务节点：P4 task assembly。创建条件、周期及资源配置见本节点和 linked source evidence。
en.effect: Queue capacities reflect their roles: state events keep multiple entries; sensor/servo snapshots use latest-value capacity one; control trace and tactile data have dedicated queues.
en.failure: The shared context carries state, target owner, control enable, scope, feedback, and task wake signals.
en.recovery: Queue/mutex/task/monitor creation failure is an assembly failure; the system must not be treated as ready.
en.unknown: The source gives static task settings and data paths, not live scheduling jitter, stack headroom, or hardware output.

en.change: The baseline does not mark this task as changed.

zh.plain: hostCommTask services the desktop serial protocol on a 5 ms nominal deadline and wakes early for received bytes. Priority 2; stack 8192 words.
zh.condition: 任务节点：hostCommTask。创建条件、周期及资源配置见本节点和 linked source evidence。
zh.effect: RX callback signals hostCommWake; the task dispatches frames through HostCommService using shared runtime state.
zh.failure: An initialization failure deletes the task; frame/command rejection occurs in the dispatcher and safety gates.
zh.recovery: Check serial initialization, host RX heartbeat, ACKs and task runtime counters.
zh.unknown: 源码给出静态任务配置与数据通路，不证明实机调度抖动、堆栈余量或硬件输出结果。
zh.difference: A 5 ms deadline is a scheduling target, not proof of byte-to-action latency.
zh.change: 基线没有把该任务标记为本次变更。

zh.plain: systemStateTask coordinates system states/events on a nominal 10 ms loop. Priority 5; stack 4096 words.

zh.effect: It reads and updates system_state, servo_target_owner, and control_enabled; changes to these fields wake motionControlTask immediately.
zh.failure: Coordinator initialization failure deletes the task; unsupported events or state changes are rejected by the state coordinator.
zh.recovery: Inspect state snapshots, event/ACK results, and runtime metrics.
zh.unknown: 源码给出静态任务配置与数据通路，不证明实机调度抖动、堆栈余量或硬件输出结果。
zh.difference: The periodic loop does not imply every UI event is applied within exactly 10 ms.

zh.plain: s3CanRxTask polls the S3-to-P4 CAN bus every 1 ms and delegates parsing/reassembly to SensorIngressService.
zh.condition: 任务节点：s3CanRxTask。创建条件、周期及资源配置见本节点和 linked source evidence。
zh.effect: It validates CAN ID, 8-byte length, fragment completeness, sequence/CRC and freshness; complete snapshots overwrite canRxQueue.
zh.failure: Initialization failure deletes the task; invalid length, missing fragments or CRC failure marks the snapshot bad and reports a communication rule.
zh.recovery: Inspect CAN IDs, RX/CRC counters, reassembly timeouts and active communication rules.
zh.unknown: 源码给出静态任务配置与数据通路，不证明实机调度抖动、堆栈余量或硬件输出结果。
zh.difference: The nominal 1 ms loop does not prove bus delivery or end-to-end sensor latency.
zh.change: 基线没有把该任务标记为本次变更。

zh.plain: runtimeMonitorTask is a low-priority observer (priority 1, stack 4096 words) that samples registered task loop, overrun and stack metrics on configured windows.

zh.plain: autoCalibrationTask is created on demand after CALIBRATE admission, captures one calibration input snapshot, runs the session, reports completion to runtime, and deletes itself. Priority 2; stack 8192 words.

zh.plain: HostCommTask 通过 postSystemEvent 发布状态事件，并用 systemStateWake 提醒状态任务尽快消费。
zh.condition: 通道/表达式：`postSystemEvent + systemStateWake`。HostCommTask posts a state event and signals systemStateWake so the state task can consume it promptly.
zh.effect: 该通知连接串口命令解析和事件队列，状态改变仍由 SystemStateTask 决定。
zh.failure: The notification connects serial command parsing to the event queue; SystemStateTask still decides the resulting state.
zh.recovery: 若事件队列/通知不可用，检查 ACK、队列诊断和状态任务运行指标。
zh.unknown: If queueing or notification fails, inspect ACKs, queue diagnostics, and state-task metrics.
zh.difference: 事件提交不等于状态转换获准。
zh.change: Posting an event does not mean the transition was admitted.

zh.plain: 新目标到达时，hostCommTask 通过 motionControlWake 提醒运动任务处理待更新目标。
zh.condition: 通道/表达式：`sharedData->motionControlWake`。When a new target arrives, hostCommTask signals motionControlWake so the motion task processes it.
zh.effect: 目标仍需经过运动状态与安全策略；唤醒信号不是伺服命令。
zh.failure: The target still passes motion-state and safety policy; a wake signal is not a servo command.
zh.recovery: 核对命令 ACK、目标队列和 motion task 运行状态。
zh.unknown: Check the command ACK, target queue, and motion-task health.
zh.difference: 这是目标数据触发的唤醒。
zh.change: This wake is triggered by target data.

zh.plain: 当 system_state、servo_target_owner 或 control_enabled 改变，状态任务发 kMotionStateChanged 让运动任务及时重新评估。
zh.condition: 通道/表达式：`sharedData->motionControlWake`。When system_state, servo_target_owner, or control_enabled changes, the state task sends kMotionStateChanged for prompt re-evaluation.
zh.effect: 运动任务读取新的状态和控制权，再决定是否允许输出。
zh.failure: The motion task reads the new state and ownership before deciding whether output is allowed.

zh.plain: 急停请求通过 servoBusWake 携带 kServoEmergencyStop 提醒伺服总线任务尽快处理 STOP。
zh.condition: 通道/表达式：`sharedData->servoBusWake`。An emergency-stop request sends kServoEmergencyStop through servoBusWake to prompt the servo-bus task to handle STOP.
zh.effect: 这是软件层紧急唤醒；总线任务随后执行其 STOP/保持策略。
zh.failure: This is a software emergency wake; the bus task then applies its STOP/hold policy.
zh.recovery: 检查 E-stop latch/token、总线响应和实际停止反馈。
zh.unknown: Inspect the E-stop latch/token, bus response, and actual stop feedback.
zh.difference: 通知成功不证明实体伺服已停或机械端处于安全状态。
zh.change: Successful notification does not prove the physical servo stopped or the mechanism is safe.

zh.plain: S3 CAN 接收服务校验并重组传感器数据后覆盖写入 canRxQueue；运动任务读取最新快照。

zh.effect: 容量 1 的快照队列优先保留新鲜数据，不保留每个采样周期的完整历史。
zh.failure: A capacity-one snapshot queue favors recent data and does not retain every sampling cycle.
zh.recovery: 检查 CAN snapshot 时间戳、valid mask、CRC 统计和 Communication 规则。
zh.unknown: Inspect CAN snapshot timestamp, valid mask, CRC counters, and Communication rules.
zh.difference: 无效帧不会成为可信新快照；旧值是否仍可用取决于 freshness 门禁。
zh.change: Invalid frames do not become trusted new snapshots; whether an older value remains usable depends on freshness gates.
